stories.title: bounded parallel issue fleet via N independent loop.sh workers
stories.description: Enable a bounded **parallel issue fleet** — run N (default 4) autonomous PO-agent dispatches concurrently instead of strictly one at a time — via N independent `loop.sh` worker instances coordinated through the existing GitHub Projects board CAS claim, without rewriting the single-threaded dispatch core.
